top_signals.title: India Airlines Cut Diwali Flights for First Time Since Covid
top_signals.summary: India’s airlines operated fewer routes during the peak Diwali travel season, signaling that rising costs and operational disruptions are beginning to cool momentum in one of the world’s fastest growing aviation markets.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
